# A04-S25: Launch preparation

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

Great news! I was really happy when I saw that Vincent was online and even looking for me. We haven't met yet, but I've always had a feeling that we are same but different :-) I must try to use some of the networking time to convince him to write an op-ed together - it would be a good way to get the project out.

I'm also really looking forward to tomorrow. Also a bit nervous, because I have prepared a presentation that is going to demand really much from me, but which I think people will find quite funny.
